facts.fact: Third-party data cited in the blog says people around the world spend over three hours a day on their phones.
facts.quote: people around the world spend [over three hours a day]

facts.fact: Third-party data cited in the blog says people around the world watch an average of 16 hours of digital video per week; the cited source is a 2017 WordStream post.
facts.quote: watch an average of [16 hours](https://www.wordstream.com/blog/ws/2017/03/08/video-marketing-statistics) of digital video per week

facts.fact: Third-party data cited in the blog says 54% of consumers want to see more videos from familiar and already well-known brands (source: Oberlo).
facts.quote: [54% of consumers](https://www.oberlo.com/blog/video-marketing-statistics) want to see more videos from familiar and often already well-known brands

facts.fact: The blog post was published on March 16, 2023.
